3. The counter affidavit on behalf of respondent no.8 , the National Highways Division Varanasi,
U.P. is on record and para-3 incorporates that the petitioner has alternative remedy under section 34 and 36 of the Arbitration and Conciliation Act, 1996 before a competent Civil Court.

4. Learned counsel for the petitioner in that Patna High Court CWJC No.16001 of 2017(2)
dt.05-05-2025 background submits that she shall be moving before appropriate Court.

5. Granting said liberty and if it is filed, the Court shall take into account that the writ petition was pending before this Court for eight years while taking up the limitation petition for condoning the delay.

6. The writ petition is disposed of.
